stem: This cartoon depicts President Woodrow Wilson calling on Congress to —

options.label: B
options.text: issue a declaration of war against Germany

options.label: C
options.text: authorize the use of funds to support Russian revolutionaries

visual_elements: cartoon of Woodrow Wilson seated, writing a paper titled 'CONGRESS CALLED TO CONVENE APRIL 2' with a document on his knee titled 'AMERICAN SHIPS SUNK WITHOUT WARNING—AMERICAN LINES LOSE'
